title: Add RAG agent tool-calling quickstarts and docs site update
author: Nora Karim
description: Adds RAG agent quickstarts and runnable tool-calling examples for Python and TypeScript plus docs site updates. Motivation: provide copy-pasteable, production-oriented examples for customers adopting retrieval-augmented generation with tool-calling (search, knowledge connectors, and safe tool invocation patterns). This PR contains quickstart guides, example apps, templates for retriever + prompt orchestration, minimal smoke tests, and docs site navigation updates so the new content is discoverable. Checklist: [x] Python quickstart added; [x] TypeScript quickstart added; [x] example apps under redwood-examples/rag-agent-tool-calling; [x] docs site sidebar and redirects updated; [x] smoke tests and CI docs job added. Testing: local smoke runs against the redwood local dev runtime, CI docs build on staging (docs-build initially failed due to a broken link, fixed in second commit). Related work: ENG-5241 (RAG quickstarts), ENG-5287 (tool-calling patterns). No breaking changes to public APIs. Manual migration: none required.
